title: Run the Holiday Rush Order Desk
summary: A front desk for Black Friday to Christmas: order and return tracking, shipping cutoffs and drafted replies you approve.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell through the holiday rush; the value is accurate cutoffs and fewer late orders.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Customers get accurate cutoffs before they buy.
Fewer late orders during the rush.
who_its_for: Small shops during the holiday rush.
